verdict.rationale: LobeHub ships official desktop and mobile apps alongside the web app. The desktop and web surfaces clearly go beyond chat: a home dashboard, tabs, a desktop terminal, local MCP connector installs, local agent setup, scheduled tasks and Pages. Evidence for the mobile app's features and for cross-platform parity is thin, limited to a tagline. Missing for 10: documented mobile feature set, explicit cross-surface feature parity matrix, independent hands-on corroboration of the apps.
